title: Amputation and ostomy status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM status codes this note supports.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension and routine stoma check.

HPI
Pt is a 61-year-old male presenting for routine follow-up. He reports feeling well today. He notes his ileostomy is functioning normally with no issues regarding output or skin integrity. He reports his blood pressure is well-controlled on current meds. No new complaints of pain or discomfort.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Amlodipine 5mg daily

Exam
Pt in no acute distress. Alert and oriented x3. CTAB. RRR. BP 128/82, HR 72. Abdomen: ileostomy site is clean, dry, and intact. No signs of irritation or inflammation around the stoma. Skin is intact.

Assessment
1. Hypertension - stable on current regimen.
2. Status post ileostomy - current and well-maintained.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Routine monitoring of blood pressure.
3. Follow up in 6 months for routine stoma check and BP monitoring.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Ileostomy in place: Z93.2, ileostomy status (HCC 463). Z43.2 is only for an encounter for care of the ileostomy itself.

distractors.why: The ileostomy is documented and present.
The visit is not for care of the ileostomy; report the status, Z93.2.
It is an ileostomy, not a colostomy.
